summary: Iteration 24 — tested (a) new backend endpoint GET /api/affiliate/top-products, and (b) _client_ip() Cloudflare rate-limit fix. Both backend and frontend behave as specified. 6/6 pytest tests pass. Frontend widget 'YOUR BEST-SELLING PRODUCTS' renders correctly with rank badges, quantities and revenue; all 5 affiliate tabs load without errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Copy: displays '1 UNITS' instead of '1 UNIT' — pluralisation bug (EN + likely FR: '1 UNITÉS').

integration_issues.issue: On the very first render after login, one product's share URL was briefly rendered as '/product/product-b?ref=' (empty code) before refCode was populated. Second read after ~1s showed the correct '?ref=TESTTOPX'. Small race between initial widget render and /affiliate/me load. Not user-visible unless user copies within <200ms. Consider gating widget render (or share URL) on refCode being truthy.

action_items: (cosmetic) Fix '1 UNITS' → '1 UNIT' / '1 UNITÉ' pluralisation in AffiliateDashboard.jsx product card.
(cosmetic) In AffiliateDashboard.jsx, avoid rendering share URL before refCode is set (or hide widget until affiliate/me resolves) to prevent brief '?ref=' empty flash.
critical_code_review_comments: AffiliateDashboard.jsx: /affiliate/top-products call and /affiliate/me happen in parallel; share URL builder depends on refCode from /affiliate/me. Consider awaiting refCode before rendering the widget's copy URL to guarantee a correct link on first paint.
server.py _client_ip: correct priority (CF-Connecting-IP > private-peer+XFF > TRUSTED_PROXIES > peer.host). Invalid CF-Connecting-IP falls back cleanly (verified with 'not-an-ip'). No issues.

server.py /affiliate/top-products: read pipeline is correct (uses payment_status='paid', excludes _id, respects limit clamp 1-20). Note: uses .limit(2000) on Mongo cursor — for very large affiliates this cap could silently under-count; acceptable at current scale, but consider aggregation pipeline ($group) for scale.
test_credentials: admin@fironova.com / [REDACTED] — verified via /app/memory/test_credentials.md. For affiliate-specific tests, a temporary user (test_affiliate_top@example.com / TestPass!2026) with an active affiliate (code TESTTOPX, id aff_test_top_1) and two seeded paid orders were created and CLEANED UP at the end.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: test user + affiliate + 2 orders seeded via motor for both backend and frontend tests, deleted at teardown. No production data affected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_affiliate_top_products_and_cf_ip.py is reusable. CF-Connecting-IP tests MUST hit http://localhost:8001 (external proxy strips CF-* headers). EmailStr rejects .test/.local TLDs — use @example.com for synthetic test emails. To run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_affiliate_top_products_and_cf_ip.py -v -p xdist -n 0 (pytest.ini enables xdist parallel by default; -n 0 avoids fixture race across workers).
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found. Both features (a) affiliate top-products widget and (b) CF-Connecting-IP rate-limit key work end-to-end as specified.
